name: Natural language intelligence layer for contacts

mentions.name: Natural language intelligence layer for contacts
mentions.description: This app provides a natural language intelligence layer for contacts: users query their network in plain language (e.g., 'Pull everyone I know who works at a Series A healthtech in the Bay Area who also went to Stanford for undergrad') and receive either structured or unstructured results. It supports large-scale data, automatically enriches contacts with up-to-date data, delivers fast and accurate results, and integrates natively with Gmail and Google Calendar.
mentions.audience: Early-stage startups with a real, immediate need, which can pilot the product for free with small qualified teams
